items.what: The rollout check in bio-plane/scripts/deploy-fleet.mjs:398-417 polls https://<name>.<sub>.workers.dev/version (15 x 4s) for every member, so a member deployed with workers_dev:false (agent-worker, R47: reachable only through the plane's service binding) can never confirm and reports ROLLOUT NOT CONFIRMED. Read such a member's /version through the plane's service binding, or report it as not reachable by design. Moved from agent-worker F1 (coordinator ruling, 5 Nov). (walk p3dev-l1)

bio-plane/test/fleetbundles.control.mjs no longer controls the fleetbundles suite: arms 1, 2, 3 and 6 edit agent-worker/dist or a source and expect the suite to see a committed artifact go stale, but since the dist pass (PR 624, f6b3977e2f) fleetbundles.test.mjs builds every member into its own temp dir and compares two builds, reading no dist/. Redesign the control so each arm fails the suite as it now runs (a source change that breaks a build or makes two builds differ), and drop the arms that test committed artifacts. Coordinator ruling 6 Nov 11:54: bundler's next layer round. (dist pass PR 624)
